recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中一片淡染、以梭形細胞為主的病灶旁，有棕色膜狀染色的小圓細胞成群聚集與散在分布，而病灶內梭形細胞本身不著色；此染色標記未標示，無法單憑此圖確認陽性細胞是否為肥大細胞，需配合 tryptase/CD117/CD25 判讀。
features: Clusters and scattered single small round cells with strong membranous brown staining
Densest positive cluster at the edge of a pale spindle-cell-rich lesion
Spindled cells within the lesion are negative
Surrounding cellular marrow with fat spaces; bone trabecula at top
Cytologic detail of positive cells limited at this magnification
describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain (DAB; marker not specified) on a bone marrow biopsy shows a cluster and scattered individual small round cells with strong membranous positivity at the periphery of a pale, spindle-cell-rich lesion; the spindle cells within the lesion are negative. Because the marker is not stated and the positive cells are round rather than spindled, this stain may highlight an accompanying lymphoid component of a mastocytosis lesion rather than the mast cells themselves. Interpretation for systemic mastocytosis requires correlation with tryptase, CD117 and CD25 stains.

ddx.dx: Systemic mastocytosis with associated lymphoid aggregate
ddx.vs: SM lesions often contain a central lymphoid aggregate rimmed by spindled tryptase+/CD25+ mast cells, and the lymphocytes stain with CD3/CD20 only.
Reactive aggregates lack surrounding spindled tryptase-positive mast cells and fibrosis.

ddx.dx: Marrow involvement by low-grade B-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: Lymphoma forms monotonous CD20+ nodules with light-chain restriction and lacks a mast cell component.
